verdict.rationale: The evidence pack confirms Figma has a components guide (figma-docs-30, mentioning translating designs into code) and general design/prototyping capabilities, but contains no direct documentation of the core mechanics of the story—variant properties, per-instance overrides, or the linking behavior between instances and main components. Missing for 10: explicit docs on component variants, override behavior, and how overrides persist while staying linked to source updates; no community/hands-on corroboration of this specific workflow.
